title: Same-stage equality detection for affine etale sections
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder, $D:I^{op}\to Scheme$ a system of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes with affine transition maps, and $c$ a limit cone. Fix $i_0$, a sheaf of sets $G$ on the small etale site of $D(i_0)$, and an affine etale object $W_0$ with quasi-compact quasi-separated structure map. In the stage section diagram [def-weil-pbc-affine-section-diagram], let $s,t$ be two sections at the SAME object $j$ of $Over(i_0^{op})$. If their images under the canonical limit cocone [def-weil-pbc-affine-section-cocone] agree, then there exist $k$ and ONE arrow $a:k\to j$ such that the transition map associated to $a$ sends $s$ and $t$ to the same section. No assertion of existence of stage representatives for arbitrary limit sections is made.

source.place: Tag 09YQ degree-zero affine argument; Tag 09YN filtered-colimit section formula, using 0EYL and 04HR

proof.text: Restrict the scheme diagram to Over(op i0); its forgetful functor is initial, so the whiskered cone remains limiting. Form E(j)=W0 times_{D(i0)} D(j), with pullback-map transitions, and its cone e with apex W0 times_{D(i0)} c.pt. The natural second projections to the whiskered diagram are cartesian; the connected-pullback limit theorem gives IsLimit e. Quasi-compactness of W0.hom makes every E(j) compact; pullback stability makes every E transition affine. These constructions and their coherence are proved explicitly in Lean from Mathlib and isPullback_pullback_map.

Apply the canonical comparison agreement-open theorem to f=D.map j.hom, G,W0,s,t, obtaining U in E(j). The limit cocone equality is exactly its criterion for h=c.pi.app j.left and k=c.pi.app i0; hence e.pi.app j inverse image U is top.

Apply exists_map_eq_top to E,e and its proved limit witness to obtain k and one arrow a:k -> j with E.map a inverse image U equal to top. The reverse direction of the same agreement-open criterion identifies this with equality under the canonical transition of etaleStageSectionDiagram. No elementwise filtered-colimit theorem is needed.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09XM agreement-open alternative to the affine-site proof; exists_map_eq_top lines 180-198; connected pullback limits. The new remaining statement is a generic non-limit compatibility lemma.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleAffineSection_sameStageEquality
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, CompactSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a)]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c) (i₀ : I)
    (G : Sheaf (D.obj (op i₀)).smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)))
    (W₀ : (D.obj (op i₀)).Etale) [QuasiCompact W₀.hom] [QuasiSeparated W₀.hom]
    [IsAffine W₀.left]
    (j : Over (op i₀))
    (s t : (etaleStageSectionDiagram D c i₀ G W₀).obj (op j))
    (hst : (etaleStageSectionCocone D c i₀ G W₀).ι.app (op j) s =
      (etaleStageSectionCocone D c i₀ G W₀).ι.app (op j) t) :
    ∃ (k : Over (op i₀)) (a : k ⟶ j),
      (etaleStageSectionDiagram D c i₀ G W₀).map a.op s =
        (etaleStageSectionDiagram D c i₀ G W₀).map a.op t
